section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study conducted in London, UK. The study recruited 509 men from the community, with a mean age of 25.18 years and mean BMI of 24.01 (self-reported). The sample was predominantly British White (73.1%), with 25.2% having college or higher education.
